title: E8 Coxeter-plane projection
description: The Coxeter plane of E8 is a 2-plane invariant under the Coxeter element (rotation by 2pi/30). Orthogonal projection of the 240 roots onto that plane is the standard 240-point portrait. This is a drawing of a root system, not a slice of spacetime and not a compactification.
definitions: Coxeter plane: real eigenplane of the Coxeter element acting on R^8.
Projection: orthogonal map R^8 to that 2-plane.
240 image points: the projected roots; some overlapping radii, 240 distinct directions in the usual drawing.
equations: c acts as rotation by 2pi/30 on the Coxeter plane
projection is linear and not injective
assumptions: The Coxeter element is a product of the eight simple reflections.
The Euclidean metric defines the orthogonal projection.
mechanism: A finite-order orthogonal transformation singles out two real invariant planes. One of them is used as the canvas for the 240-root portrait in this index.
falsification_conditions: A Coxeter element of E8 whose order is not 30.
A projection of the 240 roots onto that plane with a different count of image vectors.
confusion_guard: A 2D picture of E8 is a projection. It does not place E8 in physical 3-space and it does not invert a 27D or 11D bulk.
primary_sources: Conway and Sloane, Sphere Packings, Lattices and Groups
predictions: The projected figure has 30-fold rotational symmetry.
The lattice in R^8 is unchanged by how it is drawn.
